final_candidates.decision_summary: Trp17 (the sequence's WYGD motif) is the largest buried hydrophobic residue in the PsaE SH3-like fold; W17A strips core packing and strongly destabilizes the domain. Position verified: residue 17 = W.
Pro35 sits in the IIYPVIV turn region; substituting leucine removes the conformational constraint and introduces a bulky residue, perturbing backbone geometry. Position verified: residue 35 = P.
Gly53 lies in the conserved GSGAGG loop where backbone dihedrals require glycine; valine causes steric clash and local loop disruption. Position verified: residue 53 = G.

stop_reason.detail: Positions re-verified against the provided sequence and candidate pool stabilized; no external evidence is available to further refine rankings.

history.rationale: Glu62 may form a conserved surface salt bridge; a charge reversal could disrupt a stabilizing ionic network and PSI docking interactions.
E62K only swaps a surface-exposed charged residue; it is unlikely to destabilize the fold enough to knock out PsaE, so it is demoted in ranking.
Gly54 lies in the conserved SGSG motif where phi/psi angles require glycine; Val substitution should locally break the loop structure.
